description: This Dart file defines a Flutter widget for a Settings screen in a chess frontend app. It includes static UI components such as toggles, theme settings, and About information, with placeholder interactions.

classes.name: SettingsScreen
classes.description: A stateless widget representing the settings page with options for gameplay, appearance, and about info.

classes.name: _StubToggle
classes.description: A stateless widget representing a switch toggle with a dialog for unimplemented functionality.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI for SettingsScreen and _StubToggle, returning scaffold, app bar, list view, and list tiles.
